notes.title: Move That Box: Graphical Overhaul
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41275088/9ba36b7526927ecab9faafaa5738ccc120e768ca.png[/img]

[b]Move That Box major update 19/04/25[/b]

[b][Art style][/b]
Most of the graphics have been revamped and improved. Including tilesets, character sprites, box sprites.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/TP100zM8/New1.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FRJZ50HD/New2.png[/img]

[b][Gameplay][/b]
- Fixed a bug where player sometimes moves inappropriate after loading autosave directly into a level,
- Fixed a bug where bounce box would bounce other boxes into a wall,
- Fixed a bug where red box would sometimes drop into an incorrect position in level 36,
- Fixed a bug where bounce box would sometimes block wooden box from entering its position while bounce box was dropped into a pit,
- Fixed a bug where main menu in a hub would sometimes display incorrectly,
- A lot more smaller bugs.

[b][MISC][/b]
- Various stability improvements.

notes.title: Content update and quality of life improvements.
notes.notes:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/tej4pmH.png[/img][/center]

The time has come. Big content update and quality of life improvements are here!

- Added Levels 21 to 40,
- Added Boss Battle in World 3 and 4,
- Added tutorials in worlds 2, 3, 4,
- Added 2 new achevements,
- Added a Quick Reset option, which can be enabled in the menu level, but you can also additionally reset in the menu as always,
- Added option to switch between window and fullscreen mode.
- Added automatic gamepad support - from now on MTB will be able to tell if you play on a keyboard or a controller and will set appropriate buttons icons by itself for you,
- Added feature to detect if game has been run on steam deck. If yes, game will set correct buttons as well,
- Added new hidden skin "The Bombastic Box-man",
- Added fast travel from hub to stars worlds and fast travel from stars worlds to hub,
- When game detects a save file, cursor will be immediately on "continue" in the title screen, so no more accidental starting new game,

Bug fixes: 
- Fixed a bug where player could stuck in a loop in level 8. (Thank you MeemoCroc!)
- Fixed a bug where box in level 9 sometimes didn't appear after reset (Thank you Drent!)
- Fixed a lot of smaller bugs that were found while testing new build (Thank you Dragon Kamillo and DiscoFlower8890!)

The more content Move That Box gets, the better it becomes and the more time I have to spend preparing it for you. This is why  after 1st of may 2023, the price of Move That Box will increase to 5,99$.

notes.title: I'm still moving those boxes.
notes.notes:
Hello, Hi. Today I have a small announcement for you.

World 3 is completely playable. All levels are designed around "Mimic" mechanic where you will be constantly mimicked by enemy blob like creature. It will be released alongside world 4 presumably April 2023.

What can you expect form that update? 20 new levels, 40 challenges and 2 bosses.

After adding the world 3 and 4 update, I'm going to raise the price of early access, so now is the perfect time to buy your copy if you want to play my game.

Move That Box! is off 50% on steam right now till 20.02.2023!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YpdlnW7.png[/img]

notes.title: Move That Box! - Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
As I was finally able to get my hands on my Q3 Steam Deck, I ran some tests on Move That Box. Turns out I don't really need to change anything and game just works perfect on the Deck with Proton out of the BOX. ːlunar2019coolpigː

Text is visible, there are no problems with music or graphics and you can set buttons for Steam Deck layout in the menu.

Simply. Move That Box! plays awesome on Valve's Steam Deck.

notes.title: Get That achievement NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Exercise your mind and get these achievements[/h1]
Hi, everyone. It's me again. Happy to announce that achievements are live. You can get them by playing game normally. 

[h1]How it works?[/h1]
Everyone who have already beat early access should get achievements at first log on to a game and loading their save file.

[h1]Easy as that[/h1]
I've added new, small window that will help you to navigate through levels.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/0r1P9ol.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/0r1P9ol.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Thanks Na![/h1]
Thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199175842756]Na[/url] I was able (hopefully) fix a small bug where holes rendered in wrong places at some levels. I really appreciate the help!

[h1]Cloud saves![/h1]
From now on your saves will be automatically sent to cloud and you can access them from everywhere you like.

[h1]Bugs reports[/h1]
If you find any bugs please consider reporting them in discussions section. 

That's all for today. Have a lovely box pushing everyone!
Crashykk
